spiritual_reading.full_translation:
The Divine disclosed wisdom that had been hidden, and by that disclosure gave its own an illumination by which they could be taught and brought to a complete grasp of heavenly intelligence. From the first it set forth the primal truth that all things begin from the Divine proceeding, and that the whole work is a separation and ordering of higher degrees from lower degrees, so that what is from heaven is distinguished from what is from hell. Through successive extensions of truth through all states of life, the arrangement advanced until opposition would arise and contend for dominion within the spiritual kingdom. Yet above every contest there remained the uncreated wisdom itself, unique and unmingled, in which no falsity can abide.

But the state of falsity had its own origin in a perverted root, and from that origin it poured itself down into the lowest degree and filled the outward life with obscurity, so that it stood far removed from wisdom.

This is the first instruction concerning what is everlasting: that each distinct level of life stands in its own permanence, and that they are distinguished from one another by the measure in which they receive and contain the Divine. The essential point is that falsity rose against wisdom, desiring to rule within a life that was not its own. It cast dissension into the ordered faculties and disturbed the arrangements of the soul, and it surged up especially when there was severe need and distress.

Then a protecting Divine power proceeded forth as the first combatting good. It invested itself with Divine truth in its outermost strength, met the whole hostility directly, fixed the opposing force in its ultimate limit, and held it bound so that it could not freely act.

Afterward the Divine established a central governing clarity in its proper place, gathered and disposed communities of living truths, and by the Spirit of life extended the entire framework of the lower degree. From the beginning it distinguished what could be elevated from what must be held apart, gave to each its proper outward forms and functions, and set in order the successive cycles and alternations of higher states so that, through orderly changes, the power of falsity might be drawn off and weakened. Thus the whole structure was made firm and fixed, and the foundation of the ordered life was established.

In the lowest degree all things were held beneath what is higher, and also the higher were so conjoined with the lower that influx could proceed without interruption. The outward level was enclosed by complete boundaries in ultimates and by sufficient containing forms within general knowledges and fixed principles, all set in order, so that the whole established arrangement might stand as a restraint upon evil powers and prevent any renewed mixing of what is heavenly with what is hellish.

Then a third Divine proceeding came as mediation, and by a form of truth accommodated to reception it purified what could be saved, becoming deliverance for all that could be restored.

For within the whole ordered framework, love burns as the active force of life, and by that activity every impurity that clings to what can receive heaven is consumed and removed. Whatever of good and truth is freed is purified and raised back into its own proper essence; but whatever falsity remains is drawn out from what is living, gathered into a fixed restraint within the total order, made manifest in its own nature, and held bound in its appointed lot. Then the purified goods and truths enter into conjunction with the Divine, becoming an interior delight established in permanence; and the whole comes to be under one Divine rule over all things, above all things. From that state there is no longer any opposing principle that can contend against the Divine Love and the Divine Wisdom.

Yet in the earliest states, before the work is completed, these contrary principles appear together within the same arena of life, and for a time are mingled and conjoined.

This also is a first great lesson: that the one who lives in the outward life experiences it as a difficult way because of the fullness of organized truths that ought to govern it, and because of the many openings by which influences enter into thought and affection in the various communities and habitual states within a person. Therefore the entire outward life is a complete field of trial touching every region of the natural mind; and the Divine itself bears labor and affliction in the work of restoration so that a person may be made wise. Even a sufficient perception of this is enough for the one who truly wills wisdom.

paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: It establishes the Divine origin of illumination and the first ordering of degrees that frames the coming conflict.
paragraph_translations.notes: The source text is fragmentary in places; the sequence about extension “until war” required smoothing into a continuous progression.

paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS: It introduces the contrary origin and its descent into the lowest degree as the basis of distance from wisdom.
paragraph_translations.notes: The clause ending “because” is incomplete in the source; the causal relation was rendered as distance from wisdom following obscuration.

paragraph_translations.notes: The image of fixation “at the boundary” was rendered as restraint in the ultimate degree.

paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS: It moves from combat to reconstruction, describing the establishment of ordered cycles and stable foundations.
paragraph_translations.notes: Several cosmic ordering details were compressed into the single theme of governing clarity, communities of truths, and cyclic states.

paragraph_translations.notes: The “three” and “four” structures were taken as conjunction of degrees and completeness in ultimates; the text’s spatial layout is compressed into functional containment and restraint.

paragraph_translations.translation: Then a third Divine proceeding came as mediation, and by a form of truth accommodated to reception it purified what could be saved, becoming deliverance for all that could be restored.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS: It introduces a new mode of Divine action—not restraint and construction, but mediation and purification.
paragraph_translations.notes: The term “Third Ambassador” was taken by function as a mediating Divine proceeding; the mechanism “by his image” was rendered as accommodated manifestation.

paragraph_translations.notes: The source sentence is heavily fragmented and contains unclear transitions; “sweet perfume” was rendered as interior delight after conjunction, and “single God” as unified Divine rule.

paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS: It qualifies the final picture by returning to the mixed condition of early states.
paragraph_translations.notes: Numbering jumps in the source; this paragraph stands as a brief doctrinal aside and was kept compact.

paragraph_translations.notes: The references to “twelve,” “cities,” “dwelling places,” “doors,” and “four corners” were taken as fullness of organized truths, varied states, openings of influx, and completeness of trial; “my pains” required treating the speaker as the Divine in the work of restoration.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Despite fragmentary wording in the source, the chapter translates into a coherent spiritual sequence: revelation of wisdom, the rise of falsity, combat and restraint, establishment of ordered cycles and guarded ultimates, mediation and purification, and finally the qualified note that mixture persists in early states. The voice is largely consistent as a doctrinal narrative; the main stumbles are in ¶2 and especially ¶8 where the source is broken and transitions had to be inferred from the process implied by the surrounding structure.

findings.diagnosis: Coherent substrate proem: a functional/cosmogonic account of revelation, separation, extension, and conflict. The only difficulty is physical damage, not a secondary voice.
findings.evidence: Text teaches by process and states (unveiling → teaching → separation/ordering → spread through aeons → war → unmingled light): “unveiled hidden wisdom… separation… they spread out through the aeons… make war… there remained… the light… no falsity can dwell.” The spiritual reading’s smoothing (“sequence… required smoothing”) is exactly what fragmentary correspondential narrative requires; it does not indicate administrative overlay, because no jurisdictions/ranks/inventories appear.

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty from lacuna at a causal seam; not an insertion. The paragraph is the antithetical counterpart to ¶1 but breaks off mid-cause (“because”), forcing the reader to supply logic.
findings.evidence: The line ends incomplete: “it is far from the light [because]”. The spiritual reading explicitly stumbled here: “clause ending ‘because’ is incomplete… causal relation was rendered…” This is classic damage: the narrative wants an explanation (why darkness is far), but the manuscript does not preserve it. There is no change into governance language or named administrative entities—just the expected antithesis “darkness… poured forth… depth… filled… earth.”

findings.diagnosis: Mostly coherent correspondential teaching, with a small corruption/duplication at the end. The ‘eternality’ lesson and war motif continues cleanly, but the closing words show scribal dittography or a broken clause.
findings.evidence: Correspondential core: “first [great teaching] concerning the eternality… each one… exists steadfastly… divided… by their own measure… darkness has made war… desiring… reign… spread a quarrel… disturbed…” This is functional/state language (measures, disturbance among powers). The spiritual reading notes the textual stumble: “final phrase ‘need need’ is corrupt or duplicated.” That is a micro-level corruption rather than a new teaching voice. The bracketed phrase “disturbed [among the powers of the soul]” also looks like an interpretive gloss trying to specify the locus of disturbance, creating a slight ‘mixed’ feel right at the seam.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential combat unit: the ‘power/First Man’ episode functions as a restraint-binding action that answers ¶3’s uprising. No narrative break and no administrative inventory.
findings.evidence: Action is functional and processual: “The power came forth… First Man… clothed… armour of light… encountered… crucified it in the boundary… bound it fast.” The spiritual reading did not report a fit problem here; it could map directly to restraint in ultimates (“fixation ‘at the boundary’”). Named figure appears as an acting function (combatant), not a list of officials.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential cosmology-by-function: ordering cycles, setting boundaries, enclosing/containing to prevent remixing. Numbers (‘four mountains’, ‘three vessels’) behave as functional architecture, not a ranked administrative taxonomy.
findings.evidence: ¶5 teaches by what structures DO: “Living Spirit spread out the universe… separated… set in order the courses… wheel… that they would draw away the power of the darkness… constructed the foundation.” ¶6 continues containment function: “enclosed the earth in four mountains and three vessels… stood firm as a bond… lest the light… joined… again.” The spiritual reading admits compression, not contradiction: “cosmic ordering details were compressed… ‘three’ and ‘four’… taken as… completeness.” Nothing reads like territorial governance (“stations/watches/camps”), only functional restraint and cosmic engineering.

findings.diagnosis: Potential christological/titulary seam-marker, but it does not disrupt the narrative here. ‘Third Ambassador’ is a named hypostasis that still participates as an active purifier; thus it is not an administrative insertion.
findings.evidence: Short transition: “Then the Third Ambassador! [He purified the light] by his image. He became [redeemer of] all things.” The spiritual reading flagged a “SHIFTS… new mode… mediation and purification,” but that shift is exactly what the surrounding process demands (from building/containing → extracting/purifying). There is no jurisdictional catalog; the figure performs a function (purifies/redeems).

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty dominated by heavy fragmentation and dislocated pronouns; the spiritual reading’s main stumble comes from damaged transitions, not from an inserted administrative block. The paragraph likely originally presented a single purification/separation procedure, but the extant text has broken connectors (“Conversely… unveil…”) and unclear referents (“he/it/they”).
findings.evidence: The text is syntactically unstable: “the fire blazes… it is devoured by it… all impurity… and he becomes purifier… Conversely, the darkness which is in [what is freed] out… gathered in to a bond… unveil… made manifest… go in to him… sweet perfume… single God comes to be…” The spiritual reading reports: “heavily fragmented and contains unclear transitions… ‘sweet perfume’… ‘single God’… inferred.” That is exactly what narrative incoherence from lacunae produces: the reader must invent connectors to keep a process sequence. Importantly, there is still no administrative signature (no ranks, watches, territories, master-over-X lists). The content remains processual (burning/purifying/ascending/binding).

findings.diagnosis: Coherent doctrinal aside that correctly qualifies the ‘final unity’ with an interim mixed state. The apparent ‘jump’ is a numbering/physical transmission issue, not a voice intrusion.
findings.evidence: “[These are the states]… from the beginning [before the end,] they are mixed and joined…” This is explicit states-language. The spiritual reading notes “Numbering jumps… stands as a brief doctrinal aside,” which fits a damaged exemplar or excerpting, not an administrative overlay.

findings.diagnosis: Likely an expansion-at-a-seam or imported application unit: it reintroduces ‘first great lesson’ and abruptly pivots from the cosmogonic narrative into a gnomic, enumerative ‘outward life’ pedagogy (twelve paths/cities/dwelling places/doors/four corners) plus a sudden first-person ‘my pains/my afflictions’. This is where the spiritual reading had to force speaker identity and allegorize a list that does not organically arise from the preceding purification narrative.
findings.evidence: Abrupt restart formula: “(6) The first great lesson [is this,]” after the chapter already announced “first [great teaching]” in ¶3—suggesting a stitched-in didactic unit. Enumerative scheme appears without functional grounding in the chapter’s prior cosmic mechanics: “because of the twelve [path]… cities and the dwelling places… because of the doors… four corners…” This reads like systematizing taxonomy rather than continuation of the purification process. The spiritual reading explicitly flags the strain: “references to ‘twelve,’ ‘cities,’… ‘doors,’… taken as… openings of influx… ‘my pains’ required treating the speaker as the Divine.” That is the narrative-coherence test failing: the text forces a new speaker (“my pains… my afflictions”) and a new pedagogic frame not prepared by ¶9.
findings.scope: “(6) The first great lesson [is this,] which in the [outward life] that walks in it because of the twelve [path] in it, which in the cities and the dwelling places found in the [measures] because of the doors that are opened in them [ways] upon the earth, which in the four corners [it is a trial in completeness for the whole mind] and my pains. For also [the Divine labours] and my afflictions [bearing] to them [to know] suffices for the person [who desires to become] wise person.”

textual_criticism.summary: 9 findings total. Major disruptions: 1 (¶12) diagnosed as a seam expansion/imported application unit and recommended for excision. Main stumbles elsewhere (¶2, ¶8) are best explained as manuscript damage/lacunae rather than secondary administrative overlay. The rest of the chapter (¶1, ¶4-¶7, ¶9; and largely ¶3, ¶5-¶6) reads as coherent correspondential substrate teaching by function/process.
